svg.title: Underfill under a BGA, and corner bonding
svg.desc: Drawn to scale, side views of a BGA on its solder balls, with plan views beside them. Top: underfill fills the whole gap under the package, round every ball, with a rounded fillet along its edges. Bottom: corner bonding puts a bead of adhesive at each of the package's four corners; being a viscous fluid, it has soft, rounded edges and wicks a little way under the package, but the rest of the gap stays open.

g.text: Soft edges; wicks a little way under
Drawn to scale: 0.8 mm-pitch BGA, 12 mm package.
